title: Diamond multitool
description: Diamond multitool with pickaxe, axe and shovel
body:
mines pickaxe, axe, and shovel block tags at diamond speed,
uses diamond durability, repair material, enchantability, and drop rules,
keeps axe actions: strip logs, scrape copper, remove wax,
keeps shovel actions: make paths, extinguish campfires,
appears in Tools & Utilities,
has recipe, lang, item model, and a custom 16x16 texture.
